precondition_status.note: ACs are taken from the v0 RAW spec plus editorial requirements agreed with the PO during review. They are NOT hash-pinned to a sealed artifact, so the usual 'ACs mapped to >=1 test: 100%' guarantee is asserted against an unsealed, mutable source.

coverage.note: No coverage instrumentation exists in this build-free repo. Verification is behavioural/e2e via a real Chromium instance rather than instrumented unit coverage. Line, branch and mutation floors are therefore not evaluable and are NOT claimed as met.

e2e.determinism: 5/5 deterministic runs, re-confirmed after the SAST fix

ac_coverage.ac: AC1 home listing renders the card with correct slug/href
AC2 hero renders with webp/jpeg picture fallback and headline
AC3 one section per theme, in source-document order
AC4 scroll reveal fires via IntersectionObserver
AC6 back link resolves to home without 404
Edge: prefers-reduced-motion freezes the hero pan
Edge: image-load failure falls back without breaking the hero
Edge: no horizontal overflow at 375px; dense table scrolls in-container
Editorial: zero em-dash, no exact numeric claims, only Uncle Bob and Matt Pocock named

anti_tautology_note: Assertions were written from the spec's acceptance criteria and the PO's review directives, not from the implementation's observed behaviour. One assertion initially failed by sampling opacity before the 600ms reveal transition completed; that was a defect in the test's timing model and was fixed with polling, not by relaxing the assertion to match current behaviour.
